d:
Nitish Kumar meets Lalan Singh: bihar ki rajniti men taja ghatnakram ke tahat, purv mukhyamantri aur jediyu neta nitish kumar ne kendriy mantri rajiv ranjan sinh (lalan sinh) se patna men unke aavas par achanak mulakat ki.
